work_types.name: Aerial photography flight
work_types.reference_note: Illustrative example: a typical small multirotor's operating envelope; rain degrades image quality and is outside most consumer airframes' ingress rating. Check your aircraft's manufacturer specification and local regulations.

work_types.name: LiDAR mapping survey
work_types.reference_note: Illustrative example: survey-grade flight lines need a stable attitude, so the wind limit is tighter than for imaging; droplets and fog scatter the laser returns. Check your sensor and aircraft specifications.

work_types.name: Thermal inspection of roofs and solar arrays
work_types.reference_note: Illustrative example: radiometric readings lose contrast in heat, wind cools surfaces and masks defects, and wet surfaces distort emissivity. Check the inspection standard you report against.

work_types.name: Crop spraying by drone
work_types.reference_note: Illustrative example: spray drift rises sharply with wind, product evaporates in heat, and rain washes it off the canopy. Check the product label and local plant-protection rules, which take precedence.

work_types.name: Parcel delivery flight
work_types.reference_note: Illustrative example: assumes a weather-sealed delivery airframe rated for light rain; battery capacity limits cold-weather range. Check your aircraft's ingress rating and operating authorisation.
